name: pullboard
title: Pullboard, built on Pullboard
summary: The rules we build Pullboard with: a frozen bar on every item, a second agent on every change, and a landing gate that runs every test.

rules.text: A builder never verifies their own work.
rules.why: the agent that wrote a change is the one least likely to see what it missed.

rules.text: Every item's check fails before the change and passes after it.
rules.why: a check that passes either way proves nothing.

rules.text: Main only moves when the whole test suite passes.
rules.why: two changes can each pass alone and still break each other.

items.title: The gate runs every test in the project
items.criterion: pullboard.json names a gate, and that gate runs every test file in the project. test/gate.test.js lists the test files, checks the gate reaches each one, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- pullboard.json (its gate)
- test/gate.test.js
Test:
- test/gate.test.js lists every test file and fails on one the gate command does not run
